reason: Conversation 1 asked about the nature and location of the smell (while already advising switching off), surfaced the decisive facts - electrical/plastic smell, warm discoloured cooker switch - and then issued a firm, tailored stop with fuse-box isolation, no pulling out or DIY wiring, and a qualified engineer, correctly pointing to an overheating supply/terminal connection without over-committing to a part.
